findings.summary: The engine-side mutation gate is runtime-inert in the production pipeline assembly: build_pipeline constructs AgentRunStageActor without mutation_inputs (src/fleet_graph/graphs/dd_runner.py:176) and DevelopmentConfig carries no field to supply one, so _with_final_review_mutations always early-returns on provider None (src/fleet_graph/graphs/dd_actors.py:474) once this merges -- no real final_review stage will execute mutations or produce a receipt until the provider is wired, and the first post-merge dd single would fail closed at gate duty 5 (missing receipt refuses delivery). The frozen engine-side criteria all pass (static reachability, receipt schema, instance target), and the fix is small since repo/base/head/acceptance_commands are already in build_pipeline's closure, but the default assembled path does not yet exercise S12.3's execution duty.

The M1 wake entry handle_dd_awaiting_gate_wake (src/fleet_graph/self_gate/runner.py:451) is exported and test-covered but not invoked by any scheduler/goal-line production module; the line-side wiring remains library-level, consistent with the lineage's accepted attempt-3 form and pinned red-able by the S12.4 instance-target test.
